source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 24 aprilie — «Sfântul Ierarh Mărturisitor Ilie Iorest, Mitropolitul Transilvaniei»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 24ης Απριλίου — «Άγιος Ηλίας ο Ομολογητής εκ Ρουμανίας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 24 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing and the same day the Romanian calendar keeps him, and it is plainly the same man: the Greek names him Ηλίας ο Ομολογητής, Elias the Confessor of Romania, born in Transylvania, a monk of Putna, elected bishop of Transylvania after the death of the metropolitan Gennadius — whose repose it dates 3 September 1640 — with the consent of the voivode Vasile Lupu of Moldavia, imprisoned nine months for defending the Orthodox faith and then freed and gone to Moldavia, and elected bishop at Huşi in 1656. That is the career of Ilie Iorest, whom this folder holds off doxologia's 24 aprilie, and the corpus keeps no second Transylvanian confessor Elias. **This folder had no `dates` and now has both years**, off the page's heading «(1600 - 1678)» and its two sentences. The Greek's line calls him «εκ Ρουμανίας», of Romania, which is the modern country and not a see. It prints no hymn.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).

hymns.text: Mărturisitori ai Ortodoxiei şi buni arhipăstori ai Bisericii lui Hristos, îndreptători ai poporului, preafericiţi ierarhi purtători de biruinţă, Sfinţilor Iorest şi Sava, cei ce v-aţi învrednicit de cununa vieţii, rugaţi-vă Domnului să se mântuiască sufletele noastre.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Ierarh Ilie Iorest, Mitropolitul Transilvaniei (precum al Sfântului Ierarh Sava)

english.text: Confessors of Orthodoxy and good chief shepherds of the Church of Christ, setters-right of the people, most blessed trophy-bearing hierarchs, Saints Iorest and Sava, who were counted worthy of the crown of life, pray to the Lord that our souls be saved.
